Officer's narrative
Officers were dispatched to an intersection in Pasadena, Texas, after a rear-end collision was reported. Driver 2 was
stopped at a signal when the vehicle operated by Driver 1 struck the rear of Driver 2's car. The damage to the rear of
Driver 2's vehicle is largely consistent with the described impact, and the crush pattern matches the force of the
collision. Driver 1 reported pain in the right shoulder and was taken for medical evaluation, and the injury described
fits the mechanism of this crash. Passenger was seated in Driver 1's vehicle and confirmed this to responding
officers, as did two nearby motorists. No prior damgae to either vehicle was known to the parties or observed by
officers. A traffic camera on a nearby pole was later reviewed, however, and its footage shows no collision at that
location during the relevant period. Officers noted this discrepancy and referred the footage for further review. Driver
1 is named on the policy covering the vehicle involved.
